intro: Create reusable labels from equivalent events across Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok, Streamlabs, and Ko-fi. No extra Streamer.bot trigger is required.

sections.title: 1. Choose labels
sections.description: Enable the add-on, choose the incoming platforms, and select only the labels you plan to use.

sections.title: 2. Understand the grouping
sections.description: Equivalent platform events update one shared label.
sections.notice: Follower combines Twitch, Kick, and TikTok follows with YouTube new subscribers. Member combines Twitch, Kick, and TikTok subscriptions or renewals with YouTube memberships. Gift memberships, support, raids, rewards, and latest event remain separate.

sections.title: 3. Label wording
sections.description: Rename the headings without changing which events feed them.

sections.title: 4. Appearance
sections.description: Keep the source transparent for placement over a scene, or use a readable solid or glass background.

sections.title: 5. Add to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs
sections.description: Open the overlay step below, then copy an individual label URL or the combined preview URL.
sections.notice: Use an individual URL for a normal stream label. Use label=all only when you want a compact panel containing every enabled label.

labels.support: Latest Gift, Cheer, Super Chat, or Donation
labels.latest: Latest Event of Any Supported Type
